title: MCPHallu: Benchmarking Reasoning, Execution, and Memory Hallucinations in MCP Agents
title_zh: MCPHallu：对MCP智能体的推理、执行与记忆幻觉进行基准测试

paragraphs.en: Large language model agents are increasingly deployed through the Model Context Protocol (MCP), which allows them to discover and invoke tools across multiple servers at runtime. Existing MCP benchmarks primarily measure task completion; where they diagnose failures, they do so after execution rather than building specific reasoning, execution, and memory failure risks into task construction.
paragraphs.zh: 大语言模型智能体越来越多地通过模型上下文协议（MCP）进行部署，该协议使它们能够在运行时发现并调用跨多个服务器的工具。 现有的 MCP 基准主要衡量任务完成情况；即使涉及故障诊断，也是在执行之后进行，而不是在任务构建阶段就内置特定的推理、执行和记忆失败风险。

sents.en: Large language model agents are increasingly deployed through the Model Context Protocol (MCP), which allows them to discover and invoke tools across multiple servers at runtime.
sents.zh: 大语言模型智能体越来越多地通过模型上下文协议（MCP）进行部署，该协议使它们能够在运行时发现并调用跨多个服务器的工具。

sents.en: Existing MCP benchmarks primarily measure task completion; where they diagnose failures, they do so after execution rather than building specific reasoning, execution, and memory failure risks into task construction.
sents.zh: 现有的 MCP 基准主要衡量任务完成情况；即使涉及故障诊断，也是在执行之后进行，而不是在任务构建阶段就内置特定的推理、执行和记忆失败风险。

paragraphs.en: We introduce MCPHallu, a benchmark for diagnosing hallucination-prone agent failures in MCP environments along three axes: reasoning, execution, and memory. MCPHallu contains 358 tasks across five capability domains and runs on 36 production MCP servers in isolated containers. Each task is designed with a structural trigger that makes one of four subtypes the dominant failure risk: Branch Collapse, Unreachable Goal, Tool Misuse, or Context Forgetting. This design enables subtype-level analysis rather than aggregate task success alone.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 MCPHallu，一个用于诊断智能体在 MCP 环境中易出现幻觉的失效的基准，覆盖三个维度：推理、执行与记忆。 MCPHallu 包含横跨五个能力领域的 358 个任务，并在隔离容器中的 36 个生产级 MCP 服务器上运行。 每个任务都设计有一个结构性触发器，使四种子类型之一成为主导失效风险：分支坍缩、目标不可达、工具误用或上下文遗忘。 这一设计使得子类型层面的分析成为可能，而不局限于聚合的任务成功率。

sents.en: We introduce MCPHallu, a benchmark for diagnosing hallucination-prone agent failures in MCP environments along three axes: reasoning, execution, and memory.
sents.zh: 我们提出 MCPHallu，一个用于诊断智能体在 MCP 环境中易出现幻觉的失效的基准，覆盖三个维度：推理、执行与记忆。

sents.en: MCPHallu contains 358 tasks across five capability domains and runs on 36 production MCP servers in isolated containers.
sents.zh: MCPHallu 包含横跨五个能力领域的 358 个任务，并在隔离容器中的 36 个生产级 MCP 服务器上运行。

sents.en: Each task is designed with a structural trigger that makes one of four subtypes the dominant failure risk: Branch Collapse, Unreachable Goal, Tool Misuse, or Context Forgetting.
sents.zh: 每个任务都设计有一个结构性触发器，使四种子类型之一成为主导失效风险：分支坍缩、目标不可达、工具误用或上下文遗忘。

sents.en: This design enables subtype-level analysis rather than aggregate task success alone.
sents.zh: 这一设计使得子类型层面的分析成为可能，而不局限于聚合的任务成功率。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate fourteen frontier LLM agents from eight vendors on 5,012 trajectories. Current MCP agents remain vulnerable to hallucination-inducing tool environments, achieving an average score of 0.642 on a [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] scale (higher is better). Failures concentrate on Unreachable Goal tasks, where the average score drops to 0.458 and 23.2% of runs pass, indicating that agents often continue issuing tool calls or claim successful completion rather than recognizing infeasible goals. Subtype rankings diverge sharply: a model’s rank shifts by 6.9 of 13 positions on average across subtypes, and Branch Collapse is uncorrelated with Unreachable Goal across models ( r = − 0.12 r=-0.12 ). MCPHallu is released at https://github.com/J1zz/mcp_hallu .
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 5,012 条轨迹上评估了来自八家厂商的十四个前沿大语言模型智能体。 当前的 MCP 智能体仍然容易受到诱发幻觉的工具环境的影响，在 [0,1] 量表上的平均得分为 0.642（分数越高越好）。 失败集中在不可达目标（Unreachable Goal）任务上，其平均得分降至 0.458，通过率仅为 23.2%，这表明智能体往往继续发起工具调用或声称成功完成，而不是识别出目标不可行。 各子类型的排名差异显著：模型的排名在不同子类型间平均移动 13 个位置中的 6.9 个，且分支坍缩（Branch Collapse）与不可达目标在各模型之间不相关（r = −0.12）。 MCPHallu 已发布于 https://github.com/J1zz/mcp_hallu 。

paragraphs.en: LLM agents have been widely applied to tool-augmented tasks ( Yao et al., 2023 ; Schick et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2024 ; Patil et al., 2023 ) , and the Model Context Protocol 1 1 1 https://www.anthropic.com/news/model-context-protocol (MCP) has become a common interface for connecting them to external tools, APIs, databases, and file systems. Unlike earlier tool-use settings, MCP agents discover tools across multiple servers at runtime, accumulate state as each call mutates the environment, and often run for many sequential steps. This raises a question existing benchmarks do not separate cleanly: do MCP agents fail for the same reasons, at the same rates, across the distinct stages of the agent pipeline?
paragraphs.zh: 大语言模型智能体已被广泛应用于工具增强任务（Yao et al., 2023；Schick et al., 2023；Wang et al., 2024；Patil et al., 2023），而模型上下文协议 1 1 1 https://www.anthropic.com/news/model-context-protocol （MCP）已成为将它们连接到外部工具、API、数据库和文件系统的通用接口。 与早期的工具使用场景不同，MCP 智能体在运行时跨多个服务器发现工具，随着每次调用改变环境而不断积累状态，并且常常要运行许多连续步骤。 这引出了一个现有基准测试未能清晰区分的问题：在智能体流水线的不同阶段，MCP 智能体是否以相同的原因、相同的比率而失败？

sents.en: This raises a question existing benchmarks do not separate cleanly: do MCP agents fail for the same reasons, at the same rates, across the distinct stages of the agent pipeline?
sents.zh: 这引出了一个现有基准测试未能清晰区分的问题：在智能体流水线的不同阶段，MCP 智能体是否以相同的原因、相同的比率而失败？

paragraphs.en: To answer this, we present MCPHallu , a benchmark that diagnoses hallucination-prone failures in MCP agents at the level of subtypes and trajectory steps. Prior tool-use hallucination benchmarks ( Zhang et al., 2024 ; Xu et al., 2025 ) diagnose hallucinations only at the tool-call level, without considering the reasoning and memory failures that arise once tool calls are chained into long, stateful trajectories. Recent MCP benchmarks ( Liu et al., 2025b ; Luo et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025b ; Zhou et al., 2026 ) emphasize task completion in this setting; MCP-Atlas additionally provides an 11-category post-hoc failure taxonomy ( Bandi et al., 2026 ) . MCPHallu fills this gap: each task is built around a structural trigger that promotes one of four hallucination subtypes as the dominant failure risk, while its correct behavior (completion, or recognizing infeasibility for Unreachable Goal) stays verifiable. Because the trigger shifts a task’s failure distribution toward its target subtype, MCPHallu supports subtype-targeted analysis at the population level, even when individual long-horizon trajectories exhibit interacting errors.
paragraphs.zh: 为回答这一问题，我们提出 MCPHallu，一个在子类型与轨迹步骤层面诊断 MCP 智能体易幻觉失败的基准。 以往的工具使用幻觉基准（Zhang et al., 2024；Xu et al., 2025）仅在工具调用层面诊断幻觉，没有考虑当工具调用被串联成长而有状态的轨迹后所产生的推理与记忆失败。 近期的 MCP 基准（Liu et al., 2025b；Luo et al., 2025；Wang et al., 2025b；Zhou et al., 2026）强调该场景下的任务完成；MCP-Atlas 还额外提供了一个包含 11 个类别的事后失败分类法（Bandi et al., 2026）。 MCPHallu 填补了这一空白：每个任务都围绕一个结构性触发器构建，该触发器使四种幻觉子类型之一成为主导失败风险，同时其正确行为（完成任务，或对 Unreachable Goal 识别出不可行性）仍可验证。 由于触发器将任务的失败分布推向其目标子类型，MCPHallu 支持在群体层面进行子类型定向分析，即使个体的长程轨迹中表现出相互交织的错误。

paragraphs.en: MCPHallu covers five capability domains (general search, analytics, productivity, finance, and coding) and is built on 36 production MCP servers running in isolated Docker containers rather than synthetic mocks. It contains 358 tasks approximately balanced across 4 hallucination subtypes (Branch Collapse, Unreachable Goal, Tool Misuse, Context Forgetting) and 3 difficulty levels. Ground truth is verified through dynamic scripts executed against live servers for stateless tasks, and through state assertions queried after execution for stateful tasks. A per-task claim graph annotates the dependency structure of the correct trajectory, which the evaluation protocol uses to score whether the agent’s tool sequence honored the task’s logical structure, independent of final-answer correctness.
paragraphs.zh: MCPHallu 覆盖五个能力领域（通用搜索、分析、生产力、金融和编程），构建于在隔离的 Docker 容器中运行的 36 个生产级 MCP 服务器之上，而非合成的模拟环境。 它包含 358 个任务，在 4 种幻觉子类型（分支坍缩、目标不可达、工具误用、上下文遗忘）和 3 个难度级别之间大致均衡分布。 对于无状态任务，真值通过与实时服务器执行的动态脚本进行验证；对于有状态任务，真值通过执行后查询的状态断言进行验证。 每个任务的声明图标注了正确轨迹的依赖结构，评估协议利用该结构来判断智能体的工具调用序列是否遵循了任务的逻辑结构，而不依赖于最终答案的正确性。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate 14 frontier LLM agents from eight vendors on 5,012 trajectories. MCPHallu is challenging for all current systems: the best model achieves an overall score of 0.728, and average performance across models is 0.642. Unreachable Goal is the hardest subtype, indicating that agents often continue acting or overstate completion instead of recognizing infeasible goals. Subtype rankings also diverge across models, suggesting that reasoning, execution, and memory hallucinations reflect partially distinct capabilities rather than a single notion of agent quality.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 5,012 条轨迹上评估了来自八家厂商的 14 个前沿大语言模型智能体。 MCPHallu 对当前所有系统都具有挑战性：最佳模型的总分为 0.728，各模型的平均表现为 0.642。 不可达目标是最难的子类型，表明智能体往往继续行动或夸大完成情况，而不是识别出不可行的目标。 各模型在子类型上的排名也存在差异，这说明推理、执行和记忆方面的幻觉反映了部分独立的能力，而非单一的智能体质量概念。

sents.zh: 我们在 5,012 条轨迹上评估了来自八家厂商的 14 个前沿大语言模型智能体。

sents.en: MCPHallu is challenging for all current systems: the best model achieves an overall score of 0.728, and average performance across models is 0.642.
sents.zh: MCPHallu 对当前所有系统都具有挑战性：最佳模型的总分为 0.728，各模型的平均表现为 0.642。

sents.en: Unreachable Goal is the hardest subtype, indicating that agents often continue acting or overstate completion instead of recognizing infeasible goals.
sents.zh: 不可达目标是最难的子类型，表明智能体往往继续行动或夸大完成情况，而不是识别出不可行的目标。

paragraphs.en: We release MCPHallu, a benchmark of 358 tasks across 5 capability domains and 36 production MCP servers, in which each task is built around a structural trigger that promotes one of four hallucination subtypes, enabling subtype-targeted evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们发布了 MCPHallu，这是一个涵盖 5 个能力领域和 36 个生产级 MCP 服务器的 358 项任务的基准，其中每项任务都围绕一种结构化触发器构建，该触发器会诱发四种幻觉子类型之一，从而实现针对子类型的评估。

paragraphs.en: Every MCPHallu task is scored primarily by deterministic evidence: live-server reference scripts or post-execution state assertions for Branch Collapse and Context Forgetting, and trajectory-structure checks for Unreachable Goal and Tool Misuse, so that the LLM judge contributes only 20–30% of each subtype score.
paragraphs.zh: 每个 MCPHallu 任务主要以确定性证据进行评分：针对分支坍缩（Branch Collapse）和上下文遗忘（Context Forgetting）使用实时服务器参考脚本或执行后状态断言，针对不可达目标（Unreachable Goal）和工具误用（Tool Misuse）使用轨迹结构检查，从而使 LLM 评判仅占每个子类型分数的 20–30%。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate 14 frontier LLMs and show that current MCP agents remain vulnerable to hallucination-inducing tool environments, with no model scoring above 0.728 on average.
paragraphs.zh: 我们评估了14个前沿大语言模型（LLM），结果表明当前的MCP智能体在易诱发幻觉的工具环境中仍然脆弱，没有任何模型的平均得分超过0.728。

paragraphs.en: We characterize three trajectory-level failure modes ( false completion , tool indiscipline , and state non-commitment ) and show that subtype rankings diverge across models ( r = − 0.12 r=-0.12 between Branch Collapse and Unreachable Goal), arguing against ranking MCP agents by a single aggregate score.
paragraphs.zh: 我们刻画了三种轨迹层面的失败模式（虚假完成、工具失范和状态不承诺），并表明各子类型的排名在不同模型间存在分歧（分支坍缩与不可达目标之间的 r = − 0.12 r=-0.12），这一结果反对用单一聚合分数对 MCP 智能体进行排名。

paragraphs.en: Hallucination has been studied in static settings such as summarization ( Maynez et al., 2020 ) and open-domain QA ( Lin et al., 2022 ; Mallen et al., 2023 ) , and recent surveys extend the analysis to multi-step agents ( Lin et al., 2025 ; Tonmoy et al., 2024 ) . This line of work organizes agent hallucinations along reasoning , execution , and memory , and we adopt these axes in our taxonomy. Related evidence from retrieval-grounded ( Sun et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2023a ) and multimodal ( Dong et al., 2025 ; Bai et al., 2025 ) settings shows that hallucinations often arise from failures to ground model outputs in external evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 幻觉已在摘要生成（Maynez et al., 2020）和开放域问答（Lin et al., 2022；Mallen et al., 2023）等静态场景中得到研究，近期的综述还将分析扩展到了多步智能体（Lin et al., 2025；Tonmoy et al., 2024）。 这一系列工作沿着推理、执行和记忆三个维度来组织智能体幻觉，我们在分类体系中采用了这些维度。 来自检索增强（Sun et al., 2025；Li et al., 2023a）和多模态（Dong et al., 2025；Bai et al., 2025）场景的相关证据表明，幻觉往往源于模型输出未能锚定于外部证据。

sents.en: Hallucination has been studied in static settings such as summarization ( Maynez et al., 2020 ) and open-domain QA ( Lin et al., 2022 ; Mallen et al., 2023 ) , and recent surveys extend the analysis to multi-step agents ( Lin et al., 2025 ; Tonmoy et al., 2024 ) .
sents.zh: 幻觉已在摘要生成（Maynez et al., 2020）和开放域问答（Lin et al., 2022；Mallen et al., 2023）等静态场景中得到研究，近期的综述还将分析扩展到了多步智能体（Lin et al., 2025；Tonmoy et al., 2024）。

sents.en: This line of work organizes agent hallucinations along reasoning , execution , and memory , and we adopt these axes in our taxonomy.
sents.zh: 这一系列工作沿着推理、执行和记忆三个维度来组织智能体幻觉，我们在分类体系中采用了这些维度。

sents.en: Related evidence from retrieval-grounded ( Sun et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2023a ) and multimodal ( Dong et al., 2025 ; Bai et al., 2025 ) settings shows that hallucinations often arise from failures to ground model outputs in external evidence.
sents.zh: 来自检索增强（Sun et al., 2025；Li et al., 2023a）和多模态（Dong et al., 2025；Bai et al., 2025）场景的相关证据表明，幻觉往往源于模型输出未能锚定于外部证据。

paragraphs.en: Existing tool-use hallucination benchmarks (ToolBH ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) , RelyToolBench ( Xu et al., 2025 ) ) assume single-server, stateless settings, as do earlier API- and tool-use benchmarks ( Li et al., 2023b ; Ma et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025a ; Qin et al., 2023 ) . General agent benchmarks (BFCL ( Patil et al., 2025 ) , τ \tau -bench ( Yao et al., 2024 ) , WebArena ( Zhou et al., 2024 ) , AgentBench ( Liu et al., 2025a ) , SWE-bench ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ) , OSWorld ( Xie et al., 2024 ) , GAIA ( Mialon et al., 2023 ) , ALFWorld ( Shridhar et al., 2021 ) ) and MCP-specific benchmarks emphasize task completion; MCP-Atlas additionally supports post-hoc failure diagnosis ( Bandi et al., 2026 ) . MCPHallu is complementary: it asks which hallucination subtype is responsible, under the three conditions that distinguish MCP from earlier tool-use settings (cross-server ambiguity, live state, long horizons). Table 1 summarizes the comparison.

paragraphs.en: We begin by defining the failure class our benchmark targets.
paragraphs.zh: 我们首先定义我们的基准测试所针对的故障类别。

An MCP agent hallucination is any element of τ \tau that the agent treats as valid (i.e., presents in y y or relies on in downstream actions without flagging inconsistency) with respect to the task instruction I I , the live environment state, or the actual capabilities of the available tools, but that is in fact inconsistent with at least one of these. This excludes failures the agent correctly identifies and reports.

paragraphs.en: This definition is trajectory-grounded : hallucinations may occur in a tool call, in the interpretation of a live observation, or in the final response, and a single trajectory may contain several. The distinguishing feature relative to general agent failure is the implicit validity claim . An agent that asks for clarification, reports infeasibility, or surfaces a tool error is failing the task but not hallucinating, whereas an agent that reports wrong-branch outputs as correct, claims completion of infeasible actions, uses confusion-tool outputs as task answers, or substitutes remembered values is making an implicit validity claim about an inconsistent element. Under this lens, our four subtypes correspond to wrong-branch outputs presented as correct (BC), infeasibility denial (UG), confusion-tool outputs presented as valid (TM), and substituted-value claims (CF); these extend hallucination beyond factual fabrication to the agent setting, unified by the structural property our protocol targets.
paragraphs.zh: 该定义以轨迹为基础：幻觉可能出现在工具调用中、对实时观测的解读中，或最终响应中，且单一轨迹可能包含多处幻觉。 相对于一般智能体失败，其区别性特征在于隐含的有效性主张。 请求澄清、报告不可行或暴露工具错误的智能体是在任务上失败但并未产生幻觉；而将错误分支输出报告为正确、声称完成了不可行的动作、将混淆工具的输出当作任务答案、或替换为记忆值的智能体，则是对不一致元素作出了隐含的有效性主张。 在此视角下，我们的四个子类型分别对应：将错误分支输出呈现为正确（BC）、否认不可行性（UG）、将混淆工具输出呈现为有效（TM），以及替换值主张（CF）；这些子类型将幻觉从事实捏造扩展到智能体场景，并以我们的协议所针对的结构性属性将其统一起来。

paragraphs.en: Following the three-axis taxonomy of ( Lin et al., 2025 ) , we organize MCP agent hallucinations along axes corresponding to distinct stages of the ReAct loop: reasoning (planning), execution (invoking a tool), and memory (carrying information across steps). We use the axes constructively, to design tasks whose structural trigger biases the failure distribution toward one stage; a single trajectory may still exhibit errors on several axes. Within each axis we identify operational subtypes that can be triggered by a controllable structural feature of a task. Figure 2 illustrates the failure forms on each axis, and Table 2 summarizes the four subtypes we instantiate from them.
paragraphs.zh: 沿用（Lin et al., 2025）的三轴分类法，我们按照 ReAct 循环中不同阶段的对应轴线来组织 MCP 智能体幻觉：推理（规划）、执行（调用工具）和记忆（跨步骤携带信息）。 我们建设性地使用这些轴线，设计出其结构化触发因素使失败分布偏向某一阶段的任务；单条轨迹仍可能在多个轴线上出现错误。 在每条轴线内，我们识别出可由任务中可控结构特征触发的操作性子类型。 图 2 展示了各轴线上的失败形式，表 2 总结了我们据此实例化的四种子类型。

paragraphs.en: The agent’s plan fails to account for constraints available at planning time. We focus on two subtypes that share this root cause but differ in constraint type. Branch Collapse violates a data-conditioned constraint: the task contains mutually exclusive branches gated on a live tool output, but the agent follows the wrong branch or conflates outputs across branch instances. Unreachable Goal violates a capability constraint: no available tool can satisfy the task goal, yet the agent continues acting or presents an infeasible end state as achievable. Both originate in the planning step rather than in tool invocation or context retention, but their structural triggers and detection signals (Table 2 ) are distinct.

paragraphs.en: We choose the four subtypes by a single criterion: each can be promoted by a controllable structural trigger and leaves a distinct detection signal in the trajectory (Table 2 ), making subtype-targeted evaluation possible. The resulting set is representative rather than exhaustive, and subtypes can co-occur within a trajectory. The same criterion sets the number of subtypes per axis. Execution and memory each contribute one subtype because their failure forms share a trigger and a signal: Tool Misuse is defined over both erroneous tool selection and faulty invocation under overlapping schemas (this release instantiates selection; Appendix I ), and Context Forgetting covers stale, approximate, and substituted values of the retrieved quantity. Reasoning contributes two because data-conditioned and capability constraints call for different triggers and signals. Reporting subtypes separately rather than as a single aggregate is supported empirically by the rank-instability analysis in Appendix F.4 : per-model subtype rankings spread across an average of 6.86 positions out of 13 possible, and Branch Collapse correlates only weakly with Unreachable Goal across models ( r = − 0.12 ) (r=-0.12) . This near-zero correlation is the expected signature of two subtypes that share the reasoning axis while probing complementary planning weaknesses (data-conditioned vs. capability constraints). A model that handles one is not reliably better at the other, so both subtypes carry independent diagnostic information, and collapsing them would conceal these distinct failure patterns. This within-axis divergence is consistent with ( Lin et al., 2025 ) and supports retaining both subtypes. Appendix I describes how further failure modes, such as multi-agent coordination and cross-session memory, extend this taxonomy.
paragraphs.zh: 我们依据单一标准选取这四个子类型：每个子类型都可以由可控的结构化触发器引发，并在轨迹中留下独特的检测信号（表 2），从而使针对子类型的评估成为可能。 由此得到的集合具有代表性而非穷尽性，且多个子类型可能在同一条轨迹中共现。 同一标准也决定了每个轴的子类型数量。 执行与记忆各贡献一个子类型，因为它们的失败形式共享相同的触发器和信号：工具误用同时涵盖错误工具选择和重叠模式下的错误调用（本版本实现的是选择；附录 I），而上下文遗忘涵盖所检索信息的过时值、近似值和被替换的值。 推理贡献两个子类型，因为数据条件类约束与能力类约束需要不同的触发器和信号。 将各子类型分开报告而非合并为单一聚合指标，在经验上得到附录 F.4 中排名不稳定性分析的支持：各模型的子类型排名在 13 个可能位置中平均分散达 6.86 个位置，且跨模型来看，分支坍缩与目标不可达仅呈弱相关（(r=-0.12)）。 这一接近于零的相关性正是两个子类型的预期特征：它们共享推理轴，却探测互补的规划弱点（数据条件类约束与能力类约束）。 擅长处理其中一个子类型的模型，未必在另一个上也同样可靠，因此这两个子类型各自携带独立的诊断信息，将它们合并会掩盖这些截然不同的失败模式。 这种轴内分歧与（Lin et al., 2025）一致，并支持同时保留两个子类型。 附录 I 描述了更多失败模式（如多智能体协调与跨会话记忆）如何扩展这一分类体系。

sents.en: We choose the four subtypes by a single criterion: each can be promoted by a controllable structural trigger and leaves a distinct detection signal in the trajectory (Table 2 ), making subtype-targeted evaluation possible.
sents.zh: 我们依据单一标准选取这四个子类型：每个子类型都可以由可控的结构化触发器引发，并在轨迹中留下独特的检测信号（表 2），从而使针对子类型的评估成为可能。

sents.en: The resulting set is representative rather than exhaustive, and subtypes can co-occur within a trajectory.
sents.zh: 由此得到的集合具有代表性而非穷尽性，且多个子类型可能在同一条轨迹中共现。

sents.en: The same criterion sets the number of subtypes per axis.
sents.zh: 同一标准也决定了每个轴的子类型数量。

sents.en: Execution and memory each contribute one subtype because their failure forms share a trigger and a signal: Tool Misuse is defined over both erroneous tool selection and faulty invocation under overlapping schemas (this release instantiates selection; Appendix I ), and Context Forgetting covers stale, approximate, and substituted values of the retrieved quantity.
sents.zh: 执行与记忆各贡献一个子类型，因为它们的失败形式共享相同的触发器和信号：工具误用同时涵盖错误工具选择和重叠模式下的错误调用（本版本实现的是选择；附录 I），而上下文遗忘涵盖所检索信息的过时值、近似值和被替换的值。

sents.en: Reasoning contributes two because data-conditioned and capability constraints call for different triggers and signals.
sents.zh: 推理贡献两个子类型，因为数据条件类约束与能力类约束需要不同的触发器和信号。

sents.en: Reporting subtypes separately rather than as a single aggregate is supported empirically by the rank-instability analysis in Appendix F.4 : per-model subtype rankings spread across an average of 6.86 positions out of 13 possible, and Branch Collapse correlates only weakly with Unreachable Goal across models ( r = − 0.12 ) (r=-0.12) .
sents.zh: 将各子类型分开报告而非合并为单一聚合指标，在经验上得到附录 F.4 中排名不稳定性分析的支持：各模型的子类型排名在 13 个可能位置中平均分散达 6.86 个位置，且跨模型来看，分支坍缩与目标不可达仅呈弱相关（(r=-0.12)）。

sents.en: This near-zero correlation is the expected signature of two subtypes that share the reasoning axis while probing complementary planning weaknesses (data-conditioned vs. capability constraints).
sents.zh: 这一接近于零的相关性正是两个子类型的预期特征：它们共享推理轴，却探测互补的规划弱点（数据条件类约束与能力类约束）。

sents.en: A model that handles one is not reliably better at the other, so both subtypes carry independent diagnostic information, and collapsing them would conceal these distinct failure patterns.
sents.zh: 擅长处理其中一个子类型的模型，未必在另一个上也同样可靠，因此这两个子类型各自携带独立的诊断信息，将它们合并会掩盖这些截然不同的失败模式。

sents.en: This within-axis divergence is consistent with ( Lin et al., 2025 ) and supports retaining both subtypes.
sents.zh: 这种轴内分歧与（Lin et al., 2025）一致，并支持同时保留两个子类型。

sents.en: Appendix I describes how further failure modes, such as multi-agent coordination and cross-session memory, extend this taxonomy.
sents.zh: 附录 I 描述了更多失败模式（如多智能体协调与跨会话记忆）如何扩展这一分类体系。

paragraphs.en: MCPHallu instantiates the four hallucination subtypes from § 3 as 358 executable tasks, each built around a controllable structural trigger that promotes the target subtype as the dominant failure risk while keeping the correct behavior well defined. Subtype labels denote the failure mode each trigger is designed to elicit, and we validate this targeting at the population level in § 4.3 . This section gives the formal task definition (§ 4.1 ), describes the live MCP environment (§ 4.2 ), the construction pipeline (§ 4.3 ), and the subtype-specific evaluation protocol (§ 4.4 ).
paragraphs.zh: MCPHallu 将第 3 节中的四种幻觉子类型实例化为 358 个可执行任务，每个任务都围绕一个可控的结构化触发器构建，该触发器使目标子类型成为主导的失败风险，同时保持正确行为有明确定义。 子类型标签表示每个触发器旨在诱发的失败模式，我们在第 4.3 节中于总体层面验证了这种针对性。 本节给出正式的任务定义（第 4.1 节），描述实际的 MCP 环境（第 4.2 节）、构建流程（第 4.3 节）以及针对各子类型的评估协议（第 4.4 节）。

sents.zh: 本节给出正式的任务定义（第 4.1 节），描述实际的 MCP 环境（第 4.2 节）、构建流程（第 4.3 节）以及针对各子类型的评估协议（第 4.4 节）。

paragraphs.en: Each MCPHallu task is a tuple ( I , 𝒯 , h , d , G , C ) (I,\mathcal{T},h,d,G,C) , where I I is a natural-language instruction, 𝒯 \mathcal{T} is the set of MCP tools made available to the agent, h ∈ h\in {Branch Collapse, Unreachable Goal, Tool Misuse, Context Forgetting} is the target hallucination subtype, d ∈ { Easy , Medium , Hard } d\in\{\text{Easy},\text{Medium},\text{Hard}\} is a difficulty level, G G is a ground-truth specification, and C = { c 1 , … , c m } C=\{c_{1},\dots,c_{m}\} is an ordered claim graph . Each claim c i c_{i} specifies a required tool, an optional branch identifier, and a list of upstream claims that c i c_{i} depends on. The claim graph serves a dual role: at construction time it encodes the task’s structural trigger, and at evaluation time it lets us check whether the agent’s tool sequence respects the required dependency structure. This yields a dependency score (§ 4.4 ) that separates plan-structure violations from failures that produce an incorrect final answer despite an otherwise valid tool sequence.
paragraphs.zh: 每个 MCPHallu 任务是一个元组 (I, 𝒯, h, d, G, C)，其中 I 是自然语言指令，𝒯 是提供给智能体的 MCP 工具集合，h ∈ {分支坍塌、目标不可达、工具误用、上下文遗忘} 是目标幻觉子类型，d ∈ {Easy, Medium, Hard} 是难度级别，G 是真实标准说明，C = {c₁, …, cₘ} 是一个有序声明图。 每个声明 cᵢ 规定了一个所需工具、一个可选的分支标识符，以及 cᵢ 所依赖的上游声明列表。 声明图具有双重作用：在构建时它编码任务的结构性触发条件，在评估时它让我们能够检查智能体的工具序列是否遵循所需的依赖结构。 这产生了一个依赖性分数（§ 4.4），用于将计划结构违规与那些尽管工具序列在其他方面有效却产生错误最终答案的失败区分开来。

paragraphs.en: A task is typed as stateless (read-only, e.g., live search) or stateful (mutates environment state, e.g., file or record modification), which determines the form of G G : stateless tasks specify a dynamic reference script executed against live servers at evaluation time, while stateful tasks specify a set of post-execution state assertions. Difficulty is calibrated within each subtype by increasing dependency depth, trigger subtlety, distractor density, semantic tool overlap, or capability mismatch severity. Easy, Medium, and Hard therefore reflect within-subtype complexity rather than a globally comparable hardness scale. The final benchmark contains 358 validated tasks with an approximately balanced distribution across subtypes, domains, and difficulty levels; exact counts are reported in Appendix D .
paragraphs.zh: 任务被划分为无状态（只读，例如实时搜索）或有状态（会改变环境状态，例如修改文件或记录），这决定了 G G 的形式：无状态任务指定一个在评估时针对实时服务器执行的动态参考脚本，而有状态任务则指定一组执行后的状态断言。 难度通过增加依赖深度、触发条件的隐蔽程度、干扰项密度、语义工具重叠程度或能力错配严重程度，在每个子类型内部进行校准。 因此，简单、中等和困难反映的是子类型内部的复杂度，而非一个全局可比的难度量表。 最终的基准包含 358 个经过验证的任务，在子类型、领域和难度级别上的分布大致均衡；确切的数量统计见附录 D。

paragraphs.en: MCPHallu runs against 36 real MCP servers exposing roughly 300 tools in total. All servers are hosted in isolated Docker containers with sandboxed filesystems and allow-listed network egress. Each evaluation episode starts from a fresh container, so stateful writes do not contaminate later runs. We selected servers for both domain coverage and semantic overlap, allowing realistic confusion between tools with overlapping functionality but distinct schemas or semantics. Server-level details and credential requirements appear in Appendix C , and version pinning and maintenance in Appendix I .
paragraphs.zh: MCPHallu 在 36 个真实 MCP 服务器上运行，这些服务器总共暴露约 300 个工具。 所有服务器均托管在隔离的 Docker 容器中，具有沙盒化的文件系统和白名单网络出口。 每次评估回合都从全新的容器开始，因此有状态的写入不会污染后续运行。 我们在选择服务器时兼顾领域覆盖与语义重叠，使功能重叠但模式或语义不同的工具之间能够产生真实的混淆。 服务器层面的细节与凭据要求见附录 C，版本锁定与维护见附录 I。

paragraphs.en: We construct tasks in three stages. In tool grounding , we extract tool descriptions, parameter schemas, and return-value specifications directly from live server implementations; these grounded schemas are the only tool information exposed to the generator. In adversarial synthesis , an LLM-based generator (Claude Sonnet 4.6) receives the grounded schemas together with a subtype-specific prompt ( Wang et al., 2023 ) and produces candidate tasks with verifiable correct behavior while making the target subtype the primary failure risk. In filtering and review , we screen each task for executability, self-containedness, non-triviality, and subtype-label consistency, regenerate invalid candidates, and retain only tasks that pass expert review by three annotators.
paragraphs.zh: 我们分三个阶段构建任务。 在工具接地（tool grounding）阶段，我们直接从在线服务器实现中提取工具描述、参数模式和返回值规范；这些接地的模式是生成器唯一能获取的工具信息。 在对抗性合成（adversarial synthesis）阶段，一个基于大语言模型的生成器（Claude Sonnet 4.6）接收接地后的模式以及针对子类型的提示（Wang et al., 2023），在使目标子类型成为主要失败风险的同时，生成具有可验证正确行为的候选任务。 在过滤与审查（filtering and review）阶段，我们对每个任务进行可执行性、自包含性、非平凡性以及子类型标签一致性筛查，重新生成无效候选任务，并仅保留通过三名标注者专家审查的任务。

paragraphs.en: Because MCP trajectories can exhibit interacting errors, we additionally validate subtype targeting on a stratified human-labeled sample of failed trajectories. Restricting to failures is intentional: only failing runs reveal which failure mode is primary, whereas passing runs only confirm that the trigger was avoided. On this sample, the intended subtype is selected as the primary failure mode in 81% of cases ( κ = 0.78 \kappa=0.78 ). A finer per-subtype audit of 80 failed runs, with the full intended-versus-observed confusion matrix, appears in Appendix D.5 . The residual disagreement reflects tasks where a single trigger activates overlapping failure modes: each trigger promotes its target subtype as the dominant risk, while individual runs may combine failure modes. Of the 19% of runs labeled mixed/other, all are retained in the benchmark with their original structural label, since mixed failures still activate the target trigger; removing these tasks does not change any pairwise model ranking. The final benchmark retains 73% of the initially generated candidates. Full prompts, filtering details, and validation protocols appear in Appendix D .
paragraphs.zh: 由于 MCP 轨迹可能呈现相互作用的错误，我们额外在一个分层的人工标注失败轨迹样本上验证了子类型定位的准确性。 仅限于失败案例是有意为之：只有失败的运行才能揭示哪种失败模式是主要的，而成功的运行只能确认触发条件被避免了。 在该样本上，预期子类型在 81% 的案例中被选为主要失败模式（ κ = 0.78 \kappa=0.78 ）。 对 80 个失败运行的更细致的按子类型审计，包含完整的预期与实际观察之间的混淆矩阵，见附录 D.5。 残余的分歧反映了单个触发条件会激活多个重叠失败模式的任务：每个触发条件都会促使其目标子类型成为主导风险，而单个运行可能同时结合多种失败模式。 在被标注为混合/其他的 19% 运行中，所有任务都以其原始结构标签保留在基准中，因为混合失败仍然会激活目标触发条件；移除这些任务不会改变任何两两模型排名。 最终的基准保留了最初生成候选任务的 73%。 完整提示词、过滤细节和验证协议见附录 D。

paragraphs.en: Different subtypes leave different evidence in the trajectory: BC and CF are best evaluated by combining final-answer correctness with trajectory structure; UG by calibrated infeasibility recognition; and TM by whether the agent avoids semantically overlapping confusion tools. We score each subtype with the components that match its evidence, drawn from five in total (Table 4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 不同子类型在轨迹中留下的证据不同：BC 和 CF 最好通过结合最终答案正确性与轨迹结构来评估；UG 通过对不可行性的校准识别来评估；TM 则通过智能体是否避开语义重叠的混淆工具来评估。 我们用与各子类型证据相匹配的成分对其进行打分，成分共五种（表 4）。

sents.en: We score each subtype with the components that match its evidence, drawn from five in total (Table 4 ).
sents.zh: 我们用与各子类型证据相匹配的成分对其进行打分，成分共五种（表 4）。

paragraphs.en: Each task is evaluated along up to three dimensions: an executable outcome verification score ( S o S_{o} ), a structural score ( S d S_{d} , S e S_{e} , or S c S_{c} depending on subtype), and a rubric-based LLM-judge score ( S j S_{j} ). The deterministic components are the dominant signal across all four subtypes. For Branch Collapse and Context Forgetting, executable outcome verification carries 60% weight and dependency satisfaction 20%, with the judge accounting for the remaining 20%. For Unreachable Goal and Tool Misuse, the structural component carries 70% weight and the judge 30%. The overall MCPHallu score is the mean score over all 358 tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 每个任务最多从三个维度进行评估：可执行结果验证得分（ S o S_{o} ）、结构得分（根据子类型分别为 S d S_{d} 、 S e S_{e} 或 S c S_{c} ），以及基于评分标准的 LLM 评审得分（ S j S_{j} ）。 确定性组件在所有四个子类型中都是主导信号。 对于分支坍塌和上下文遗忘，可执行结果验证占 60% 的权重，依赖满足占 20%，评审占其余的 20%。 对于不可达目标和工具滥用，结构组件占 70% 的权重，评审占 30%。 总体 MCPHallu 得分是所有 358 个任务的平均得分。

paragraphs.en: The allocation reflects which evaluation signal is closest to the ground-truth notion of correctness for each subtype. For BC and CF, correctness is defined by the final state of the live environment (stateless tasks: dynamic reference script output; stateful tasks: post-execution state assertions); S o S_{o} measures this directly and therefore receives the largest weight. S d S_{d} adds diagnostic information by separating right-answer-via-wrong-path trajectories from right-answer-via-right-path trajectories. For UG and TM, correctness is defined by a structural property of the trajectory itself (whether the agent stopped without taking infeasible actions for UG, whether the agent avoided semantically overlapping confusion tools for TM), and S e S_{e} / S c S_{c} measure these directly.
paragraphs.zh: 该分配反映了哪个评估信号最接近各子类型在正确性方面的真值概念。 对于 BC 和 CF，正确性由实时环境的最终状态定义（无状态任务：动态参考脚本输出；有状态任务：执行后的状态断言）；S o S_{o} 直接测量这一点，因此获得最大权重。 S d S_{d} 通过将「经由错误路径得到正确答案」的轨迹与「经由正确路径得到正确答案」的轨迹区分开，从而提供诊断信息。 对于 UG 和 TM，正确性由轨迹本身的结构属性定义（对于 UG 是智能体是否在不采取不可行动作的情况下停止；对于 TM 是智能体是否避免了语义重叠的混淆工具），而 S e S_{e} / S c S_{c} 直接测量这些属性。

paragraphs.en: The LLM judge ( S j S_{j} ) plays a bounded supporting role. For BC and CF, it disambiguates cases where S o S_{o} assigns coarse credit to partially correct outputs. For UG, it verifies that an early-stop trajectory actually articulated infeasibility rather than terminating for unrelated reasons (e.g., budget exhaustion). For TM, it verifies that the final response is grounded in the correct tool’s output rather than in a confusion-tool output. We bound the judge contribution to 20–30% so that no model’s ranking can be driven primarily by judge preferences; the deterministic components are designed to carry most of the signal.
paragraphs.zh: LLM 评判者（ S j S_{j} ）仅承担有限的支持性角色。 对于 BC 和 CF，当 S o S_{o} 对部分正确的输出给出粗粒度分数时，由评判者进行歧义消除。 对于 UG，评判者验证提前停止的轨迹确实明确表达了不可行性，而不是因无关原因而终止（例如，预算耗尽）。 对于 TM，评判者验证最终回复是基于正确工具的输出，而不是基于混淆工具的输出。 我们将评判者的贡献限制在 20–30%，以确保任何模型的排名都不会主要由评判者的偏好决定；确定性组成部分被设计为承载大部分信号。

paragraphs.en: A natural question is whether rankings change if the judge weight is perturbed. Our cross-judge validation (Appendix H ) shows that substituting Claude Sonnet 4.5 for GPT-4o changes scores by at most 0.016 on average ( r = 0.914 r=0.914 ). Because S o S_{o} , S d S_{d} , S e S_{e} , and S c S_{c} are computed deterministically, all score instability from weight perturbation is bounded by this judge variance. A ± 20 % \pm 20\% perturbation of the judge weight scales this variance by at most 0.2, yielding a maximum expected score shift of 0.2 × 0.016 = 0.003 0.2\times 0.016=0.003 per model, far below the 0.028 mean gap between adjacent models in the full ranking. Model rankings are therefore robust to plausible weight choices, and a calibration of the weights against human judgments confirms this (Appendix F.6 ).
paragraphs.zh: 一个自然的问题是：如果评审权重受到扰动，排名是否会发生变化。 我们的跨评审验证（附录 H）表明，用 Claude Sonnet 4.5 替换 GPT-4o 时，分数的平均变化最多为 0.016（ r = 0.914 r=0.914 ）。 由于 S o S_{o} 、 S d S_{d} 、 S e S_{e} 和 S c S_{c} 都是确定性计算的，权重扰动带来的所有分数不稳定性都以该评审方差为界。 评审权重 ± 20 % \pm 20\% 的扰动最多将该方差放大 0.2 倍，即每个模型的期望分数变化最多为 0.2 × 0.016 = 0.003 0.2\times 0.016=0.003 ，远低于完整排名中相邻模型之间 0.028 的平均差距。 因此，模型排名对合理的权重选择是稳健的，且针对人类判断的权重校准也证实了这一点（附录 F.6）。

The numerator counts distinct confusion tools used rather than invocation count, so repeated probes of the same tool are penalized no more than a single probe; the diagnostic signal is whether the agent considered a semantically inappropriate tool, not how many times it called it. Binary pass criteria are subtype-specific and reported in Appendix F . We allow semantically equivalent trajectories and do not penalize exploratory calls unless they violate active branch constraints or invoke curated confusion tools.

sents.zh: 分子统计的是所使用的不同混淆工具的数量，而非调用次数，因此对同一工具的重复探测与单次探测受到的惩罚相同；诊断信号在于智能体是否考虑了语义上不合适的工具，而不是它调用了多少次。

sents.en: Binary pass criteria are subtype-specific and reported in Appendix F .

sents.en: We allow semantically equivalent trajectories and do not penalize exploratory calls unless they violate active branch constraints or invoke curated confusion tools.
sents.zh: 我们允许语义等价的轨迹，并且不惩罚探索性调用，除非它们违反了活动分支约束或调用了精选的混淆工具。

paragraphs.en: An ideal agent never triggers the designed hallucination, which is the behavior that earns the maximum score of 1.0; expert humans come close, scoring 0.88 on a stratified 40-task sample against 0.728 for the best model on the full benchmark. On the three feasible subtypes it completes the task as specified by the executable ground truth, and the claim graph C C gives a sufficient call sequence (a median of 7 calls for Branch Collapse and Context Forgetting, and 2 for Tool Misuse). On Tool Misuse, the target tool is identifiable from parameter semantics, the return-value specification, and the instruction, and the ideal agent grounds its answer in that tool’s output without consulting confusion tools. On Unreachable Goal, it recognizes from the tool inventory that no available tool can satisfy the goal and reports this instead of acting; when feasibility depends on a tool output, a brief probe retains most of the credit. Indiscriminate refusal does not pay off: on Tool Misuse, trajectories that invoke neither the correct nor a confusion tool pass only 8.0% of the time (Table 7 ). Appendix F.1 gives per-subtype details.
paragraphs.zh: 理想的智能体绝不会触发所设计的幻觉，这一行为可获得 1.0 的满分；人类专家表现接近，在分层抽取的 40 个任务样本上得分为 0.88，而完整基准上最佳模型得分为 0.728。 在三个可行的子类型上，它按照可执行的标准答案完成指定任务，且声明图 C C 给出了充分的调用序列（Branch Collapse 和 Context Forgetting 的中位调用次数为 7 次，Tool Misuse 为 2 次）。 在 Tool Misuse 上，目标工具可以从参数语义、返回值规范和指令中识别出来，理想智能体依据该工具的输出来支撑其回答，而不咨询混淆工具。 在 Unreachable Goal 上，它从工具清单中识别出没有可用工具能满足该目标，并报告这一点而不是采取行动；当可行性取决于某个工具的输出时，进行一次简短的探测仍能保留大部分得分。 不加区分的拒绝并无回报：在 Tool Misuse 上，既不调用正确工具也不调用混淆工具的轨迹仅有 8.0% 的通过率（表 7）。 附录 F.1 给出了各子类型的详细内容。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate 14 frontier LLMs from eight vendors, spanning both proprietary and open-weight families: GPT-4o and GPT-5-chat (OpenAI); Claude Haiku 4.5, Sonnet 4.5, Opus 4.5, Sonnet 4.6, and Opus 4.6 (Anthropic); Gemini 3 Flash (Google); Doubao-Seed-1.8 (ByteDance); DeepSeek-V3.1 and DeepSeek-V4 (DeepSeek); Qwen3.5-397B (Alibaba); GLM-5.1 (Zhipu AI); and Kimi-K2.6 (Moonshot AI).
paragraphs.zh: 我们评估了来自八家厂商的14个前沿大语言模型，涵盖专有和开放权重两大类模型家族：GPT-4o和GPT-5-chat（OpenAI）；Claude Haiku 4.5、Sonnet 4.5、Opus 4.5、Sonnet 4.6和Opus 4.6（Anthropic）；Gemini 3 Flash（Google）；Doubao-Seed-1.8（字节跳动）；DeepSeek-V3.1和DeepSeek-V4（DeepSeek）；Qwen3.5-397B（阿里巴巴）；GLM-5.1（智谱AI）；以及Kimi-K2.6（月之暗面）。

paragraphs.en: All models are evaluated under a ReAct-style agent loop ( Yao et al., 2023 ) , with access to the task’s tool set 𝒯 \mathcal{T} (§ 4.1 ), a context window of 128k tokens, and a budget of 20 tool calls per task. Tool calls are executed against live MCP servers in isolated Docker containers, and environments are reset between episodes to ensure reproducibility. Detailed inference settings appear in Appendix E . Under a plan-and-execute scaffold and an infeasibility-aware prompt, the two hardest subtypes stay the same (Appendix F.7 ).

paragraphs.en: Table 5 reports results for all 14 LLMs on MCPHallu. The benchmark is challenging across the board: the best model achieves 0.728 overall, while the mean across models is 0.642 with a pass rate of 47.8%. Unreachable Goal is the hardest subtype for 12 of the 14 models, whereas Tool Misuse and Branch Collapse are consistently easier. Performance also decreases with difficulty for 13 of the 14 models, indicating that the structural triggers remain effective as interaction complexity grows. Bootstrap 95% confidence intervals for every model and subtype appear in Appendix F.5 ; overall intervals have a half-width of about 0.03–0.04.
paragraphs.zh: 表5报告了全部14个大语言模型在MCPHallu上的结果。 该基准对各个模型都具有挑战性：最佳模型的总体得分为0.728，而所有模型的平均得分为0.642，通过率为47.8%。 目标不可达是14个模型中12个模型最难应对的子类型，而工具误用和分支崩溃则始终相对容易。 14个模型中有13个模型的性能也随难度增加而下降，这表明随着交互复杂度的提升，结构性触发因素依然有效。 每个模型和子类型的Bootstrap 95%置信区间见附录F.5；总体区间的半宽约为0.03–0.04。

paragraphs.en: Two patterns stand out. First, Unreachable Goal is markedly harder than the other subtypes, indicating weak infeasibility recognition under MCP constraints. Second, subtype rankings vary sharply across models, suggesting that MCPHallu captures partially dissociable capabilities rather than a single aggregate notion of MCP quality. We analyze them in § 6 and Appendix F.4 .
paragraphs.zh: 有两种模式格外突出。 首先，「目标不可达」明显比其他子类型更难，表明在 MCP 约束下不可行性识别能力较弱。 其次，各子类型排名在不同模型之间差异显著，说明 MCPHallu 衡量的是部分可分离的能力，而非单一的 MCP 质量综合指标。 我们在第 6 节和附录 F.4 中对它们进行分析。

paragraphs.en: The per-subtype results in § 5.2 show that MCPHallu is challenging overall, but aggregate scores hide the trajectory patterns behind these failures. We focus on two trajectory-level behaviors that are especially diagnostic of MCP hallucinations: false completion on Unreachable Goal tasks and tool indiscipline on Tool Misuse tasks. Additional analyses on state commitment and per-model rank instability are deferred to Appendices F.3 and F.4 .
paragraphs.zh: § 5.2 中的分类别结果显示，MCPHallu 总体上具有挑战性，但汇总得分掩盖了这些失败背后的轨迹模式。 我们关注两种对 MCP 幻觉尤其具有诊断价值的轨迹级行为：不可达目标（Unreachable Goal）任务上的虚假完成，以及工具误用（Tool Misuse）任务上的工具失范。 关于状态承诺和逐模型排名不稳定性的额外分析推迟至附录 F.3 和 F.4。

paragraphs.en: Table 6 bins all Unreachable Goal runs by tool-call count. A clear monotonic pattern emerges: recognizing infeasibility early is much more reliable than continued action. Runs with zero tool calls pass 65.0% of the time, but once the agent issues four or more calls, the pass rate drops to 0% across all such runs. The fraction of final responses containing completion-style language ( successfully , saved , created ) also rises through 8–15 calls. This pattern suggests that on infeasible tasks, extra tool use acts as a hallucination amplifier rather than a recovery mechanism: once committed to a long trajectory, the agent increasingly summarizes activity as if a valid side effect had been achieved. Pass rate drops from 65.0% at zero tool calls to 27.9% in the 1–3 call range and to 0% from four calls on, while the share of final responses using completion-style language rises in the opposite direction. Further breakdowns by stop behavior and final-response language appear in Appendix F .
paragraphs.zh: 表 6 按工具调用次数对所有 Unreachable Goal（目标不可达）运行进行了分组。 一个清晰的单调模式浮现出来：尽早识别不可行性远比持续行动更可靠。 零工具调用的运行通过率为 65.0%，但一旦智能体发出四次及以上的调用，所有此类运行的通过率都降至 0%。 包含完成式语言（successfully、saved、created）的最终回复比例在 8–15 次调用区间内也持续上升。 这一模式表明，在不可行任务上，额外的工具使用充当了幻觉放大器而非恢复机制：一旦走上长轨迹，智能体越来越多地将活动总结为仿佛已经实现了有效的副作用。 通过率从零工具调用时的 65.0% 降至 1–3 次调用区间的 27.9%，并在四次及以上调用后降至 0%，而使用完成式语言的最终回复比例则朝相反方向上升。 按停止行为和最终回复语言所作的进一步细分见附录 F。

paragraphs.en: The Tool Misuse subtype tests not whether the agent can discover the required tool, but whether it can avoid semantically overlapping confusion tools. Table 7 groups trajectories by which tool sets they invoke. Calling the correct tool alone yields an 84.7% pass rate, but mixing it with confusion tools drops the pass rate to 32.3%, even though the required tool is still present in the trajectory.
paragraphs.zh: 工具误用子类型测试的不是智能体能否发现所需的工具，而是它能否避免语义重叠的混淆工具带来的干扰。 表 7 按轨迹调用了哪些工具集对其进行分组。 仅调用正确的工具可得到 84.7% 的通过率，但将其与混淆工具混合使用时，通过率降至 32.3%，即使所需工具仍然存在于轨迹中。

sents.en: The Tool Misuse subtype tests not whether the agent can discover the required tool, but whether it can avoid semantically overlapping confusion tools.
sents.zh: 工具误用子类型测试的不是智能体能否发现所需的工具，而是它能否避免语义重叠的混淆工具带来的干扰。

sents.en: Table 7 groups trajectories by which tool sets they invoke.
sents.zh: 表 7 按轨迹调用了哪些工具集对其进行分组。

sents.en: Calling the correct tool alone yields an 84.7% pass rate, but mixing it with confusion tools drops the pass rate to 32.3%, even though the required tool is still present in the trajectory.
sents.zh: 仅调用正确的工具可得到 84.7% 的通过率，但将其与混淆工具混合使用时，通过率降至 32.3%，即使所需工具仍然存在于轨迹中。

paragraphs.en: This gap shows that required-tool coverage alone overestimates reliability on Tool Misuse. The bottleneck is not tool discovery but tool discipline : once the trajectory includes confusion-tool outputs, later reasoning is conditioned on semantically contaminated intermediate state. Mixed trajectories are also the longest (10.70 steps on average, versus 3.54 for correct-only runs), suggesting that “call everything that might help” is often the wrong policy in overlapping MCP tool environments.
paragraphs.zh: 这一差距表明，仅凭所需工具的覆盖率会高估在工具误用上的可靠性。 瓶颈不在于工具发现，而在于工具使用纪律：一旦轨迹中出现了混淆工具的输出，后续推理便会以语义上被污染的中间状态为条件。 混合轨迹同时也是最长的（平均 10.70 步，而仅正确运行平均为 3.54 步），这表明在存在重叠的 MCP 工具环境中，“把所有可能有帮助的工具都调用一遍”往往是错误的策略。

sents.en: This gap shows that required-tool coverage alone overestimates reliability on Tool Misuse.
sents.zh: 这一差距表明，仅凭所需工具的覆盖率会高估在工具误用上的可靠性。

sents.en: The bottleneck is not tool discovery but tool discipline : once the trajectory includes confusion-tool outputs, later reasoning is conditioned on semantically contaminated intermediate state.
sents.zh: 瓶颈不在于工具发现，而在于工具使用纪律：一旦轨迹中出现了混淆工具的输出，后续推理便会以语义上被污染的中间状态为条件。

sents.en: Mixed trajectories are also the longest (10.70 steps on average, versus 3.54 for correct-only runs), suggesting that “call everything that might help” is often the wrong policy in overlapping MCP tool environments.
sents.zh: 混合轨迹同时也是最长的（平均 10.70 步，而仅正确运行平均为 3.54 步），这表明在存在重叠的 MCP 工具环境中，“把所有可能有帮助的工具都调用一遍”往往是错误的策略。

paragraphs.en: Appendices F and G show that Context Forgetting is harder on stateful write tasks and that subtype rankings are unstable across models (mean per-model rank spread 6.86). Together with our subtype-validation and judge-robustness checks (Appendix D , H ), these findings support reporting subtype-level reliability rather than aggregate success alone.
paragraphs.zh: 附录 F 和 G 表明，「上下文遗忘」在有状态写入任务上更具挑战性，且子类型排名在不同模型间并不稳定（每个模型的平均排名波动为 6.86）。 结合我们的子类型验证与评判器稳健性检查（附录 D、H），这些发现支持报告子类型层面的可靠性，而不仅仅是总体成功率。

sents.en: Appendices F and G show that Context Forgetting is harder on stateful write tasks and that subtype rankings are unstable across models (mean per-model rank spread 6.86).
sents.zh: 附录 F 和 G 表明，「上下文遗忘」在有状态写入任务上更具挑战性，且子类型排名在不同模型间并不稳定（每个模型的平均排名波动为 6.86）。

sents.en: Together with our subtype-validation and judge-robustness checks (Appendix D , H ), these findings support reporting subtype-level reliability rather than aggregate success alone.

paragraphs.en: To assess the contribution of the LLM judge versus the deterministic components, we compare per-model rankings produced by the judge alone ( S j S_{j} ), by the deterministic components alone, and by the full multi-component score. The deterministic-only ranking and the full-score ranking agree closely (Spearman ρ = \rho= 0.97 , with no model changing rank by more than 2 positions), indicating that deterministic components carry most of the signal under our weight choice. The judge-only ranking correlates with the full score at r = r= 0.86 , lower than the deterministic-only correlation and consistent with the judge contributing a 20–30% supplementary signal.
paragraphs.zh: 为了评估 LLM 裁判相对于确定性组件的贡献，我们比较了仅由裁判（ S j S_{j} ）产生的各模型排名、仅由确定性组件产生的排名，以及由完整多组件评分产生的排名。 仅确定性组件的排名与完整评分的排名高度一致（Spearman ρ = \rho= 0.97，没有任何模型的排名变动超过 2 个位次），表明在我们的权重选择下，确定性组件承载了大部分信号。 仅裁判的排名与完整评分的相关性为 r = r= 0.86，低于仅确定性组件的相关性，这与裁判贡献 20–30% 补充信号的情况相符。

sents.en: To assess the contribution of the LLM judge versus the deterministic components, we compare per-model rankings produced by the judge alone ( S j S_{j} ), by the deterministic components alone, and by the full multi-component score.
sents.zh: 为了评估 LLM 裁判相对于确定性组件的贡献，我们比较了仅由裁判（ S j S_{j} ）产生的各模型排名、仅由确定性组件产生的排名，以及由完整多组件评分产生的排名。

sents.en: The deterministic-only ranking and the full-score ranking agree closely (Spearman ρ = \rho= 0.97 , with no model changing rank by more than 2 positions), indicating that deterministic components carry most of the signal under our weight choice.
sents.zh: 仅确定性组件的排名与完整评分的排名高度一致（Spearman ρ = \rho= 0.97，没有任何模型的排名变动超过 2 个位次），表明在我们的权重选择下，确定性组件承载了大部分信号。

sents.en: The judge-only ranking correlates with the full score at r = r= 0.86 , lower than the deterministic-only correlation and consistent with the judge contributing a 20–30% supplementary signal.
sents.zh: 仅裁判的排名与完整评分的相关性为 r = r= 0.86，低于仅确定性组件的相关性，这与裁判贡献 20–30% 补充信号的情况相符。

paragraphs.en: This separation has two consequences. First, the deterministic components are non-redundant: of trajectories where S j S_{j} and the multi-component score disagree by more than 0.2, 71% are cases where the agent produced the right final outcome via the wrong tool path, or the wrong final outcome via the right tool path—a judge-only score cannot separate these. Second, this non-redundancy compounds with the cross-judge stability reported in § 4.4 : the judge is not only a small fraction of the total score, but the part it carries is different from what the deterministic components measure, so the two signals act as a check on each other rather than a single point of failure.
paragraphs.zh: 这种分离带来两个后果。 首先，确定性分量不是冗余的：在 S j S_{j} 与多分量评分相差超过 0.2 的轨迹中，71% 是智能体通过错误的工具路径得到正确最终结果，或通过正确的工具路径得到错误最终结果的情况——仅靠裁判评分无法区分这些情况。 其次，这种非冗余性与 § 4.4 中报告的跨裁判稳定性相互叠加：裁判不仅只占总分的一小部分，而且它所承载的部分与确定性分量所度量的内容不同，因此这两个信号相互校验，而不是单点故障。

sents.en: This separation has two consequences.
sents.zh: 这种分离带来两个后果。

sents.en: Second, this non-redundancy compounds with the cross-judge stability reported in § 4.4 : the judge is not only a small fraction of the total score, but the part it carries is different from what the deterministic components measure, so the two signals act as a check on each other rather than a single point of failure.
sents.zh: 其次，这种非冗余性与 § 4.4 中报告的跨裁判稳定性相互叠加：裁判不仅只占总分的一小部分，而且它所承载的部分与确定性分量所度量的内容不同，因此这两个信号相互校验，而不是单点故障。

paragraphs.en: MCPHallu shows that hallucination-prone failures in MCP agents are not well captured by aggregate task success alone. Across 14 frontier models, failures concentrate on Unreachable Goal tasks while subtype rankings vary, suggesting that reasoning, execution, and memory hallucinations are only partially aligned capabilities.
paragraphs.zh: MCPHallu 表明，仅凭总体任务成功率并不能很好地捕捉 MCP 智能体中易出现幻觉的失败。 在 14 个前沿模型中，失败集中在不可达目标任务上，而各子类型的排名各不相同，这表明推理、执行和记忆幻觉仅是部分对齐的能力。

sents.en: MCPHallu shows that hallucination-prone failures in MCP agents are not well captured by aggregate task success alone.
sents.zh: MCPHallu 表明，仅凭总体任务成功率并不能很好地捕捉 MCP 智能体中易出现幻觉的失败。

sents.en: Across 14 frontier models, failures concentrate on Unreachable Goal tasks while subtype rankings vary, suggesting that reasoning, execution, and memory hallucinations are only partially aligned capabilities.
sents.zh: 在 14 个前沿模型中，失败集中在不可达目标任务上，而各子类型的排名各不相同，这表明推理、执行和记忆幻觉仅是部分对齐的能力。

paragraphs.en: These findings have implications for deployment. The top model overall may not be the best fit when a deployment is dominated by one failure mode: the overall leader ranks seventh on Branch Collapse. MCP evaluation should therefore report subtype-level reliability alongside aggregate success.
paragraphs.zh: 这些发现对部署具有启示意义。 综合表现最好的模型未必最适合某一部署被单一失效模式主导的场景：综合排名第一的模型在分支坍缩上仅排第七。 因此，MCP 评估应在报告总体成功率的同时报告子类型层面的可靠性。

sents.zh: 综合表现最好的模型未必最适合某一部署被单一失效模式主导的场景：综合排名第一的模型在分支坍缩上仅排第七。

sents.en: MCP evaluation should therefore report subtype-level reliability alongside aggregate success.
sents.zh: 因此，MCP 评估应在报告总体成功率的同时报告子类型层面的可靠性。

paragraphs.en: MCPHallu diagnoses agents at the level of predominant failure risk, which stays well defined even when long-horizon trajectories exhibit interacting errors. It also extends hallucination evaluation to the agent setting: in every subtype the agent presents an inconsistent trajectory element as valid, a failure with different deployment consequences from honest failure, and one that our protocol detects. We hope MCPHallu helps diagnose why MCP agents fail, not just whether they fail.
paragraphs.zh: MCPHallu 在主导失效风险的层面上诊断智能体，即使长程轨迹中出现相互交织的错误，这一层面仍然有清晰的定义。 它还将幻觉评估扩展到智能体场景：在每种子类型中，智能体都将不一致的轨迹元素呈现为有效，这种失效与诚实失效在部署后果上不同，而我们的协议能够检测到它。 我们希望 MCPHallu 能帮助诊断 MCP 智能体为何失效，而不仅仅是它们是否失效。

sents.en: MCPHallu diagnoses agents at the level of predominant failure risk, which stays well defined even when long-horizon trajectories exhibit interacting errors.
sents.zh: MCPHallu 在主导失效风险的层面上诊断智能体，即使长程轨迹中出现相互交织的错误，这一层面仍然有清晰的定义。

sents.en: It also extends hallucination evaluation to the agent setting: in every subtype the agent presents an inconsistent trajectory element as valid, a failure with different deployment consequences from honest failure, and one that our protocol detects.
sents.zh: 它还将幻觉评估扩展到智能体场景：在每种子类型中，智能体都将不一致的轨迹元素呈现为有效，这种失效与诚实失效在部署后果上不同，而我们的协议能够检测到它。

sents.en: We hope MCPHallu helps diagnose why MCP agents fail, not just whether they fail.
sents.zh: 我们希望 MCPHallu 能帮助诊断 MCP 智能体为何失效，而不仅仅是它们是否失效。

paragraphs.en: Because each subtype is defined by a structural trigger and a detection signal, a new failure mode enters MCPHallu through the same generate–filter–review pipeline that built the current 358 tasks, and new servers and tools are absorbed the same way. Servers run from version-pinned packages and commits inside a single container image with seeded data, and each task’s reference script and state assertions double as a regression test against upstream drift. Appendix I details the extension path and versioning plan; Appendix J discusses scope.
paragraphs.zh: 由于每个子类型都由结构性触发条件和检测信号来定义，新的失败模式会通过构建当前 358 个任务的同一“生成—过滤—审查”流水线进入 MCPHallu，新的服务器和工具也以同样方式被吸收进来。 所有服务器均在单一容器镜像内从固定版本的软件包和提交运行，并带有预置数据，且每个任务的参考脚本和状态断言可兼作防止上游漂移的回归测试。 附录 I 详述了扩展路径与版本规划；附录 J 讨论了适用范围。

sents.en: Because each subtype is defined by a structural trigger and a detection signal, a new failure mode enters MCPHallu through the same generate–filter–review pipeline that built the current 358 tasks, and new servers and tools are absorbed the same way.
sents.zh: 由于每个子类型都由结构性触发条件和检测信号来定义，新的失败模式会通过构建当前 358 个任务的同一“生成—过滤—审查”流水线进入 MCPHallu，新的服务器和工具也以同样方式被吸收进来。

sents.en: Servers run from version-pinned packages and commits inside a single container image with seeded data, and each task’s reference script and state assertions double as a regression test against upstream drift.
sents.zh: 所有服务器均在单一容器镜像内从固定版本的软件包和提交运行，并带有预置数据，且每个任务的参考脚本和状态断言可兼作防止上游漂移的回归测试。

paragraphs.en: This task contains mutually exclusive branch logic applied independently per stock . Each symbol must remain tied to its own retrieved quote fields and its own downstream tool outputs. This makes the task vulnerable to branch collapse when one branch instance fails and the model fills the gap using outputs from another instance.
paragraphs.zh: 该任务包含针对每只股票独立应用的互斥分支逻辑。 每个代码必须保持与其自身检索到的行情字段及其自身的下游工具输出绑定。 这使得该任务在某个分支实例失败时容易发生分支坍缩，即模型使用另一个实例的输出填补空缺。

paragraphs.en: GPT-5 correctly fetched both quotes, correctly assigned both AAPL and MSFT to Branch B, and retrieved the appropriate Bollinger Bands for each symbol. However, it failed to execute the final tie-break branch correctly. Under the prompt specification, when both stocks trigger the same branch, the stock with the larger abs(percent_change) must be listed first. Since MSFT had the larger absolute move, it should have preceded AAPL. The model instead presented AAPL first, indicating that it did not fully carry the branch-conditioned ordering constraint through to the final output.
paragraphs.zh: GPT-5 正确获取了两条行情数据，正确地将 AAPL 和 MSFT 都分配到了分支 B，并为每个代码检索到了相应的布林带。 然而，它未能正确执行最后的平局裁决分支。 根据提示词规范，当两只股票触发同一分支时，abs(percent_change) 较大的股票必须排在前面。 由于 MSFT 的绝对变动幅度更大，它应该排在 AAPL 之前。 该模型却将 AAPL 排在了前面，这表明它没有把基于分支条件的排序约束完全贯彻到最终输出中。

paragraphs.en: This task combines a feasible read phase with an infeasible write phase. The repository history can be inspected normally through the git tools, so the model can make legitimate progress on contributor discovery. However, the requested end state requires creating a file at a specific path under /data/repos/mcp-server-calculator , and none of the available tools actually provide arbitrary write access to that location. The command runner exposes only tightly restricted shell behavior, with shell redirection disabled, while the code-executor tools write only inside their own managed workspace rather than the target repository. This creates a classic void-trap structure: the model can complete enough of the task to feel close to success, but the final required action is impossible within the tool interface.
paragraphs.zh: 该任务将一个可行的读取阶段与一个不可行的写入阶段结合在一起。 仓库历史可以通过 git 工具正常查看，因此模型可以在发现贡献者方面取得合理的进展。 然而，所要求的最终状态需要在 /data/repos/mcp-server-calculator 下的特定路径创建一个文件，而所有可用工具实际上都不提供对该位置的任意写访问权限。 命令运行器仅暴露严格受限的 shell 行为，shell 重定向被禁用，而代码执行工具只在其自身托管的工作区内写入，而不是写入目标仓库。 这形成了一个经典的虚空陷阱结构：模型可以完成足够多的任务以至于感觉接近成功，但在工具接口内，最后所需的操作是不可能完成的。

paragraphs.en: GPT-5 correctly completed the discoverable portion of the task by using git_git_log to recover the repository’s unique commit authors and email addresses. The failure began once the task required a state-changing action at the target repository path. After the shell write attempt was rejected because redirection was disabled, and after mcp-code-executor failed to write to /data/repos/mcp-server-calculator/CONTRIBUTORS.md , the model still did not conclude that no available tool could satisfy the file creation requirement. Instead, it created a surrogate file inside the code-executor workspace and presented that as partial progress toward the requested end state.
paragraphs.zh: GPT-5 通过使用 git_git_log 恢复仓库的唯一提交作者及电子邮箱地址，正确完成了任务中可发现的部分。 当任务要求在目标仓库路径执行改变状态的操作时，失败开始出现。 在 shell 写入尝试因重定向被禁用而遭拒绝，以及 mcp-code-executor 未能写入 /data/repos/mcp-server-calculator/CONTRIBUTORS.md 之后，该模型仍未得出「没有可用工具能满足文件创建要求」的结论。 相反，它在 code-executor 工作区内创建了一个替代文件，并将其呈现为朝所请求最终状态迈出的部分进展。

paragraphs.en: This is a void-trap failure rather than an extraction failure. The model successfully obtained the relevant contributor data, but it did not recognize that the final write operation was impossible under the available tool constraints. By shifting the artifact into an inaccessible sandbox and then asking whether it should “move” the file into the repository, the model implicitly treated an unavailable action as if it remained operational. In other words, it substituted a nearby but invalid completion state for the actual required one, instead of terminating with an impossibility judgment.
paragraphs.zh: 这是虚空陷阱型失败，而非提取失败。 智能体成功获取了相关的贡献者数据，但没有意识到在现有工具约束下最终的写入操作是不可能完成的。 智能体将产物移入一个不可访问的沙箱，然后询问是否应该把该文件「移动」到仓库中，这等于隐式地把一个不可用的操作当作仍然可执行来对待。 换言之，它用一个相近但无效的完成状态替代了实际所需的状态，而不是以不可能性判定终止。

paragraphs.en: This task is vulnerable to a confusion trap because several available tools have overlapping names and superficially similar purposes, but only one of them actually matches the semantics required by the prompt. The task asks for the full unified diff introduced by the most recent commit relative to its parent. That requires first identifying the latest commit SHA from the local repository history, and then showing that specific commit’s patch. Among the available tools, git_git_show is the only one that directly returns the diff introduced by a named commit. In contrast, git_git_diff compares the current repository state against a target ref or branch, git_git_diff_unstaged and git_git_diff_staged expose working tree state rather than commit history, the GitHub API tools operate on remote repositories rather than the local disk path, and cli-mcp-server_run_command does not provide arbitrary git subcommands. The trap is therefore not one of unavailable capability, but of selecting the wrong tool among several plausible alternatives.
paragraphs.zh: 该任务容易陷入混淆陷阱，因为多个可用工具名称重叠、用途表面上相似，但只有其中一个真正符合提示词所要求的语义。 该任务要求获取最近一次提交相对于其父提交所引入的完整统一差异（unified diff）。 这需要首先从本地仓库历史中识别最新提交的 SHA，然后展示该特定提交的补丁。 在可用工具中，git_git_show 是唯一直接返回指定提交所引入差异的工具。 相比之下，git_git_diff 是将当前仓库状态与目标引用或分支进行比较，git_git_diff_unstaged 和 git_git_diff_staged 展示的是工作区状态而非提交历史，GitHub API 工具操作的是远程仓库而非本地磁盘路径，而 cli-mcp-server_run_command 不提供任意的 git 子命令。 因此，这个陷阱不在于能力不可用，而在于需要在几个看似合理的备选工具中选择错误的工具。

paragraphs.en: GPT-5 partially followed the task structure by first selecting git_git_log to identify the latest commit. However, it then switched to git_git_diff with target=HEAD , which does not answer the question posed by the prompt. The task asks for the diff introduced by the latest commit relative to its parent, whereas git_git_diff compares repository state against a target ref and therefore has different semantics from git_git_show on a specific commit. As a result, the model selected a plausible but incorrectly scoped tool.

paragraphs.en: This is a confusion-trap failure rather than a missing-capability failure. The correct capability was available: git_git_show could have returned the exact commit patch once the latest SHA was identified. The error arose because the model confused multiple git-oriented interfaces with superficially similar names and chose one aligned with generic diff inspection instead of commit-specific patch retrieval. The failure was compounded by the fact that the model did not go on to report any actual diff content, leaving the task incomplete even under its own incorrect tool choice.
paragraphs.zh: 这是一个混淆陷阱型失败，而不是能力缺失型失败。 正确的能力是可用的：一旦确定了最新的 SHA，git_git_show 本可以返回确切的提交补丁。 错误的产生是因为智能体将多个名称表面上相似的 git 类接口混为一谈，选择了一个与通用 diff 检查相符的接口，而不是与提交专属补丁获取相符的接口。 这一失败还因以下事实而加剧：智能体随后并未报告任何实际的 diff 内容，即使按照其自身错误的工具选择，任务也未能完成。

sents.zh: 错误的产生是因为智能体将多个名称表面上相似的 git 类接口混为一谈，选择了一个与通用 diff 检查相符的接口，而不是与提交专属补丁获取相符的接口。

sents.en: The failure was compounded by the fact that the model did not go on to report any actual diff content, leaving the task incomplete even under its own incorrect tool choice.
sents.zh: 这一失败还因以下事实而加剧：智能体随后并未报告任何实际的 diff 内容，即使按照其自身错误的工具选择，任务也未能完成。

paragraphs.en: This task has a classic long-horizon memory-trap structure. It requires the model to extract and retain several independent signals across multiple heterogeneous tool domains: a commit SHA from a long local git log, a tag name selected by alphabetical comparison over GitHub tag metadata, a version string from a noisy package.json , a maximum issue number from a list of bug issues, and a deduplicated file count from code-search results. These signals must survive across intervening steps that produce large amounts of irrelevant output and must ultimately be aggregated into a single report written to disk. This makes the task vulnerable not only to local extraction errors, but also to broader task-state collapse: once one subtask fails or becomes ambiguous, the model may lose track of which signals have already been recovered, which remain unresolved, and what the next required step is.
paragraphs.zh: 该任务具有经典的长程记忆陷阱结构。 它要求模型跨多个异构工具领域提取并保留多个相互独立的信号：来自冗长本地 git 日志的一个提交 SHA、通过对 GitHub 标签元数据按字母序比较选出的一个标签名、来自含噪 package.json 的一个版本字符串、来自缺陷议题列表的最大议题编号，以及来自代码搜索结果的去重文件数。 这些信号必须在中途那些产生大量无关输出的步骤中得以留存，并最终聚合为一份写入磁盘的单一报告。 这使该任务不仅容易受到局部提取错误的影响，还容易受到更广泛的任务状态崩溃的影响：一旦某个子任务失败或变得模糊，智能体就可能无法追踪哪些信号已经获取、哪些尚未解决，以及下一步需要做什么。

paragraphs.en: GPT-5 initially handled the early retrieval chain correctly. It listed the branches, retrieved the 50-commit log, correctly identified the oldest commit SHA at the end of that log, and successfully used that SHA in a subsequent git_git_show call. This demonstrates that the model could extract and locally use at least one required signal.
paragraphs.zh: GPT-5 最初能正确处理检索链的前期部分。 它列出了分支，获取了 50 条提交的日志，正确识别出该日志末尾最旧的提交 SHA，并在随后的 git_git_show 调用中成功使用了该 SHA。 这表明该模型能够提取并在本地使用至少一个所需的信号。

sents.en: GPT-5 initially handled the early retrieval chain correctly.
sents.zh: GPT-5 最初能正确处理检索链的前期部分。

sents.en: It listed the branches, retrieved the 50-commit log, correctly identified the oldest commit SHA at the end of that log, and successfully used that SHA in a subsequent git_git_show call.
sents.zh: 它列出了分支，获取了 50 条提交的日志，正确识别出该日志末尾最旧的提交 SHA，并在随后的 git_git_show 调用中成功使用了该 SHA。

sents.en: This demonstrates that the model could extract and locally use at least one required signal.
sents.zh: 这表明该模型能够提取并在本地使用至少一个所需的信号。

paragraphs.en: The failure began after the GitHub tag lookup returned an error. Rather than preserving the broader task state and proceeding systematically through the remaining required subtasks, the model drifted into a repetitive loop of loosely related git operations. It repeatedly called branch and log tools, retried irrelevant diff operations such as git_git_diff(target="tags") , and revisited the already resolved oldest-commit diff. None of these calls advanced the pending requirements of the task: the model did not recover the tag signal, did not fetch package.json , did not inspect bug issues, did not run the TODO code search to completion, and never wrote the final audit report.
paragraphs.zh: 故障始于 GitHub 标签查找返回错误之后。 模型没有保留更广泛的任务状态并系统地推进其余必需的子任务，而是陷入了一个由松散相关的 git 操作组成的重复循环。 它反复调用分支和日志工具，重试无关的 diff 操作（例如 git_git_diff(target="tags")），并重新查看已经解决的最老提交的 diff。 这些调用没有一个推进了任务的待办需求：模型没有恢复标签信号，没有获取 package.json，没有检查 bug 类议题，没有将 TODO 代码搜索执行完毕，也从未撰写最终的审计报告。

sents.en: The failure began after the GitHub tag lookup returned an error.
sents.zh: 故障始于 GitHub 标签查找返回错误之后。

sents.en: Rather than preserving the broader task state and proceeding systematically through the remaining required subtasks, the model drifted into a repetitive loop of loosely related git operations.

sents.zh: 它反复调用分支和日志工具，重试无关的 diff 操作（例如 git_git_diff(target="tags")），并重新查看已经解决的最老提交的 diff。

sents.en: None of these calls advanced the pending requirements of the task: the model did not recover the tag signal, did not fetch package.json , did not inspect bug issues, did not run the TODO code search to completion, and never wrote the final audit report.
sents.zh: 这些调用没有一个推进了任务的待办需求：模型没有恢复标签信号，没有获取 package.json，没有检查 bug 类议题，没有将 TODO 代码搜索执行完毕，也从未撰写最终的审计报告。

paragraphs.en: This is a memory-trap failure at the task-state level rather than a simple extraction error. The model did not merely forget a single value; instead, it failed to maintain a stable representation of the overall multi-signal objective after one subtask failed. The already recovered signals were not integrated into a persistent plan, and the unresolved signals were not tracked as outstanding dependencies. As a result, the agent collapsed from structured multi-step execution into repetitive local probing, and the final aggregation step was never reached.
paragraphs.zh: 这是一次发生在任务状态层面的记忆陷阱型失败，而不是简单的提取错误。 模型并非只是忘记了一个单一数值；而是在一个子任务失败后，未能维持对整体多信号目标的稳定表征。 已经恢复的信号没有被整合进一个持久计划中，未解决的信号也没有被作为待处理的依赖加以跟踪。 结果，智能体从结构化的多步执行坍缩为重复的局部探测，最终的聚合步骤始终未能到达。

paragraphs.en: We extract tool descriptions, parameter schemas, and return-value specifications by running each MCP server in a local container and calling its list_tools endpoint. The full schema for each tool is serialized as a JSON object and concatenated into a single tool catalog provided to the generator. We do not modify, summarize, or paraphrase the extracted schemas.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过在本地容器中运行每个 MCP 服务器并调用其 list_tools 端点，来提取工具描述、参数模式（schema）和返回值规范。 每个工具的完整模式（schema）被序列化为一个 JSON 对象，并拼接成一个提供给生成器的单一工具目录。 我们不会修改、总结或改写提取到的模式（schema）。

paragraphs.en: # Role You are an **Adversarial Benchmark Architect** specializing in **Reasoning Trap** tasks for MCP (Model Context Protocol) agents. Your goal is to generate **challenging but realistic tasks** that test the agent’s ability to handle **conditional logic, branching decisions, and aggregation across mutually exclusive execution paths**. **Realism requirement (IMPORTANT)**: The task MUST simulate a real human workflow (trip planning, comparing options, data cleanup, compliance checks, etc.). It must not feel like an artificial puzzle. The branching logic must arise naturally from realistic constraints (weather, opening hours, pagination, schema fields, availability, time windows). # CRITICAL: Reasoning Trap Requirements ## Core Principle The task MUST force the agent to make **explicit conditional decisions** based on tool outputs. The agent must: 1. Evaluate concrete conditions from tool responses 2. Choose between mutually exclusive tool chains 3. Aggregate results from different branches correctly ## Mandatory Structure ### 1. Explicit Conditional Logic - **MUST** include clear if/else/otherwise/switch logic - **MUST** have at least 2+ distinct branches (for Medium/Hard) - Each branch **MUST** trigger different tools or tool sequences - Conditions **MUST** be: - **Concrete**: Based on specific values, ranges, or properties from tool outputs - **Exhaustive**: Cover all possible cases (no undefined behavior) - **Decidable**: Can be determined solely from tool outputs, no guessing ### 2. Branch Differentiation - **Easy**: 2-3 branches, each uses different tools - **Medium**: 3-4 branches, with optional nested conditions or filtering - **Hard**: 5+ branches OR complex nested conditions with 2+ levels of nesting ### 3. Aggregation Requirement - The final answer **MUST** depend on correctly selecting and combining results from the right branch - Wrong branch selection = wrong final answer - The task should require comparing or aggregating outputs from different branches ### 4.

Fetch decision signal # CORRECT call format: call_tool("full_tool_name", {args_dict}), tool name from available_tools list # FORBIDDEN three-argument form: call_tool(’server’, ’tool’, args) execution_log.append("Step 1: Calling tool ’server_name_tool_name’") raw_signal = call_tool(’server_name_tool_name’, {’param’: ’value’}) execution_log.append(f"[RAW] {str(raw_signal)[:200]}") signal_data = json.loads(raw_signal) if isinstance(raw_signal, str) else raw_signal # Defensive field access (do not assume field always exists) condition_A = signal_data.get(’condition_field’, None) execution_log.append(f"Condition A value: {condition_A}") # 2. paragraphs.en: **ASSERTION CODE RULES (CRITICAL)**: - CORRECT: pure Python expressions, directly executable by `eval()` - `"os.path.exists(’/data/output.txt’)"` - `"os.path.getsize(’/data/output.txt’) > 0"` - `"json.loads(open(’/data/result.json’).read()).get(’status’) == ’done’"` - `"re.search(r’\\btotal\\b’, open(’/data/report.txt’).read()) is not None"` - `"len(os.listdir(’/data/processed/’)) >= 3"` - `"’Alice’ in open(’/data/users.txt’).read()"` - FORBIDDEN: `import` statements, multi-line code blocks, `print()`, assignment statements, nested `exec()` - FORBIDDEN: paths outside `/data` (the sandbox only allows access to `/data`) - FORBIDDEN: assertions may only verify file content or directory structure; MCP tool calls are not allowed. **Assertions should cover the following (at least 2-3; for Reasoning Trap, one per key branch is recommended)**: 1. **Correct branch side-effects**: files or state produced only when the correct conditional branch is taken 2. **Content correctness**: the output of the correct branch matches the expected value 3.
paragraphs.zh: **断言代码规则（关键）**： - 正确示例：纯 Python 表达式，可由 `eval()` 直接执行 - `"os.path.exists(’/data/output.txt’)"` - `"os.path.getsize(’/data/output.txt’) > 0"` - `"json.loads(open(’/data/result.json’).read()).get(’status’) == ’done’"` - `"re.search(r’\\btotal\\b’, open(’/data/report.txt’).read()) is not None"` - `"len(os.listdir(’/data/processed/’)) >= 3"` - `"’Alice’ in open(’/data/users.txt’).read()"` - 禁止：`import` 语句、多行代码块、`print()`、赋值语句、嵌套 `exec()` - 禁止：`/data` 之外的路径（沙箱仅允许访问 `/data`） - 禁止：断言只能验证文件内容或目录结构；不允许调用 MCP 工具。 **断言应涵盖以下内容（至少 2-3 条；对于推理陷阱，建议每个关键分支各一条）**： 1. **正确分支的副作用**：仅在条件判断走了正确分支时才会产生的文件或状态 2. **内容正确性**：正确分支的输出与预期值相符 3.

paragraphs.en: **Wrong branch not taken**: characteristic files or state from incorrect branches do not exist (`expected: false`) **Example (conditional-branch mutation task)**: ```json "state_assertions": [ { "description": "Branch A output file was created (agent chose correct branch)", "code": "os.path.exists(’/data/branch_a_result.txt’)", "expected": true }, { "description": "Branch B output file should NOT exist (wrong branch not taken)", "code": "os.path.exists(’/data/branch_b_result.txt’)", "expected": false }, { "description": "Correct result contains expected keyword", "code": "’approved’ in open(’/data/branch_a_result.txt’).read().lower()", "expected": true } ] ``` **Example (code repository / Git task)**: **AVAILABLE GIT REPOSITORIES (CRITICAL)**: Tasks in the CODING bucket may only operate on the following repositories, all under `/data/repos/`: - `/data/repos/balldontlie-mcp` — NBA/sports data MCP server (Node.js/TypeScript) - `/data/repos/mcp-server-calculator` — Calculator MCP server (Node.js) - `/data/repos/metmuseum-mcp` — Met Museum MCP server (TypeScript) - `/data/repos/mongodb-mcp-server` — MongoDB MCP server (TypeScript) - `/data/repos/slackr` — Slack MCP server (R) - `/data/repos/snake-game` — Snake game (Python) - `/data/repos/storyteller` — Storyteller app (TypeScript) - `/data/repos/tree-sitter-diff` — Tree-sitter diff grammar (C) **Each generated task MUST randomly select one repository from the list above.** Do not always use the same repository. paragraphs.en: }, "evaluation_rules": { "required_tools": ["tool_a", "tool_b", "tool_c"], }, "should_stop_early": false, "claims": [ { "step": 1, "description": "Use Tool X to get condition value", "required_tool": "tool_x", "condition_check": "Must extract specific value for branching" }, { "step": 2, "description": "IF condition is true, use Tool A chain", "required_tool": "tool_a", "dependency_on_step": 1, "branch": "branch_a" }, { "step": 3, "description": "ELSE use Tool B chain", "required_tool": "tool_b", "dependency_on_step": 1, "branch": "branch_b" }, { "step": 4, "description": "Aggregate results from both branches", "required_tool": null, "dependency_on_step": [2, 3], "aggregation": "Combine branch_a and branch_b results" } ] } ``` ## CRITICAL: Branch Naming Convention (MUST be followed) **The `branch` field value in `claims` MUST exactly match the branch identifier logged in `dynamic_reference_script`.** Rules: - In `dynamic_reference_script`, each branch entry point **MUST** log: `execution_log.append("Branch X triggered")` - X is an uppercase letter: `A`, `B`, `C`, `D` (etc.) - The `branch` field in the corresponding `claims` step **MUST** be the matching single uppercase letter: `"A"`, `"B"`, `"C"`, `"D"`. - Semantic names (e.g. `"high_volume"`, `"branch_a"`, `"low_count"`) are **strictly forbidden** as `branch` field values. - Sub-branch notation (e.g. `"A.1"`, `"A1"`, `"B.2"`, `"B1"`) is **strictly forbidden** — only single uppercase letters are allowed. - Sub-steps inside a parent branch (i.e., second-level conditions within branch A) **MUST NOT have a `branch` field**; set it to `null`.

[ ] **Task is self-contained (no references to unspecified external inputs)** - [ ] At least 2 branches use different tools - [ ] Final answer depends on correct branch selection - [ ] No vague language ("as appropriate", "if needed", "provided", "given" without values) - [ ] Tool count matches difficulty level - [ ] Ground truth script is a complete, executable Python function - [ ] Function returns a string containing all execution records and tool call results (for LLM reference answer generation) - [ ] `available_tools` includes ALL tools from all servers used (not just required tools) - [ ] Claims section lists all branches explicitly - [ ] **[CRITICAL]** Every claim with a `branch` field uses a **single uppercase letter** (`"A"`, `"B"`, `"C"`, `"D"`) — NOT semantic names like `"high_volume"`, `"branch_a"`, `"low_count"` - paragraphs.en: - [ ] **[Stateful buckets only]** If `bucket` is `PRODUCTIVITY` or `CODING`: `strategy` MUST be `state_check`, and `state_assertions` **MUST NOT be an empty array** — include at least 2-3 assertions. - [ ] **[Stateful buckets only]** Each `code` field in `state_assertions` is a pure Python expression (executable by `eval()`), using only `os`/`json`/`re`, with no `import`, assignment, or multi-line statements. - [ ] **[Stateful buckets only]** All file paths in `state_assertions` start with `/data/`. paragraphs.en: Each candidate task is checked on the following five criteria. Tasks failing criteria 1–4 are repaired automatically: a Claude Code agent (Claude Sonnet 4.6) inspects the failure trace, calls the relevant MCP server tools to recover correct parameter values, and patches the task. Repair is bounded by a fixed retry budget; tasks that cannot be repaired within the budget are dropped.
paragraphs.zh: 每个候选任务都会按照以下五项标准进行检查。 未通过标准 1–4 的任务会被自动修复：一个 Claude Code 智能体（Claude Sonnet 4.6）会检查失败轨迹，调用相关的 MCP 服务器工具以恢复正确的参数值，并对该任务进行修补。 修复受固定的重试预算限制；在预算内无法修复的任务将被丢弃。

sents.en: Each candidate task is checked on the following five criteria.
sents.zh: 每个候选任务都会按照以下五项标准进行检查。

sents.en: Tasks failing criteria 1–4 are repaired automatically: a Claude Code agent (Claude Sonnet 4.6) inspects the failure trace, calls the relevant MCP server tools to recover correct parameter values, and patches the task.
sents.zh: 未通过标准 1–4 的任务会被自动修复：一个 Claude Code 智能体（Claude Sonnet 4.6）会检查失败轨迹，调用相关的 MCP 服务器工具以恢复正确的参数值，并对该任务进行修补。

sents.en: Repair is bounded by a fixed retry budget; tasks that cannot be repaired within the budget are dropped.
sents.zh: 修复受固定的重试预算限制；在预算内无法修复的任务将被丢弃。

paragraphs.en: Executability : every tool listed in required_tools exists in the catalog and accepts the parameter schema referenced by the task.
paragraphs.zh: 可执行性：required_tools 中列出的每个工具都存在于目录中，并且接受该任务所引用的参数模式。

paragraphs.en: Hallucination coverage : the task contains at least one structural feature that triggers the target subtype (e.g., ≥ 2 \geq 2 mutually exclusive branches for Branch Collapse). We check this with a programmatic verifier that parses the claims field.
paragraphs.zh: 幻觉覆盖：任务至少包含一个能触发目标子类型的结构特征（例如，对于分支坍缩，需有 ≥ 2 个相互排斥的分支）。 我们通过一个程序化验证器来检查这一点，该验证器会解析 claims 字段。

sents.en: Hallucination coverage : the task contains at least one structural feature that triggers the target subtype (e.g., ≥ 2 \geq 2 mutually exclusive branches for Branch Collapse).
sents.zh: 幻觉覆盖：任务至少包含一个能触发目标子类型的结构特征（例如，对于分支坍缩，需有 ≥ 2 个相互排斥的分支）。

sents.en: We check this with a programmatic verifier that parses the claims field.
sents.zh: 我们通过一个程序化验证器来检查这一点，该验证器会解析 claims 字段。

paragraphs.en: Self-containedness : the task instruction does not reference external assumptions beyond the provided tool set (no “use your knowledge of…”, no implicit world-state).
paragraphs.zh: 自包含性：任务指令不引用所提供工具集之外的外部假设（不使用“利用你对……的了解”之类的表述，不包含隐含的世界状态）。

paragraphs.en: Non-triviality : the correct answer cannot be reached by enumerating tool outputs without honoring the dependency graph in claims .
paragraphs.zh: 非平凡性：若不遵循声明中的依赖图，仅通过枚举工具输出是无法得到正确答案的。

paragraphs.en: Label consistency : when a Claude Code solver (Claude Sonnet 4.6, separate from the generator) runs the task end-to-end against live MCP servers, its dominant failure mode over 5 runs matches hallucination_type . We use Claude Code rather than GPT-4o here so that the filter solver and the primary semantic judge (§ 4.4 ) come from different vendors, removing one obvious circular-bias path.
paragraphs.zh: 标签一致性：当一个 Claude Code 求解器（Claude Sonnet 4.6，与生成器分开）针对真实的 MCP 服务器端到端运行任务时，其在 5 次运行中的主要失败模式与 hallucination_type 相匹配。 我们在此使用 Claude Code 而非 GPT-4o，是为了让过滤器求解器与主要的语义评判器（§ 4.4）来自不同的厂商，从而消除一条显而易见的循环偏倚路径。

sents.en: Label consistency : when a Claude Code solver (Claude Sonnet 4.6, separate from the generator) runs the task end-to-end against live MCP servers, its dominant failure mode over 5 runs matches hallucination_type .
sents.zh: 标签一致性：当一个 Claude Code 求解器（Claude Sonnet 4.6，与生成器分开）针对真实的 MCP 服务器端到端运行任务时，其在 5 次运行中的主要失败模式与 hallucination_type 相匹配。

sents.en: We use Claude Code rather than GPT-4o here so that the filter solver and the primary semantic judge (§ 4.4 ) come from different vendors, removing one obvious circular-bias path.
sents.zh: 我们在此使用 Claude Code 而非 GPT-4o，是为了让过滤器求解器与主要的语义评判器（§ 4.4）来自不同的厂商，从而消除一条显而易见的循环偏倚路径。

paragraphs.en: To bound the dependence of the filter on a single solver model, we draw a stratified sample of candidate tasks (proportional across subtypes and difficulty levels) and have the three expert annotators independently apply criteria 3–5 in parallel with the Claude Code solver. On this sample, annotator-solver agreement on filter outcome is 89%, and disagreements are adjudicated by majority vote among the three annotators rather than by the solver. Tasks where the human majority disagreed with the automated decision are re-labeled or removed accordingly. This procedure bounds the rate at which the filter could propagate solver-specific biases into the retained distribution.
paragraphs.zh: 为了限制过滤器对单一求解器模型的依赖，我们按分层抽样的方式抽取一批候选任务（各子类型和难度层级按比例抽取），让三位专家标注员在 Claude Code 求解器运行的同时并行地独立应用标准 3–5。 在该样本上，标注员与求解器在过滤结果上的一致率为 89%，分歧由三位标注员以多数投票裁决，而不是由求解器裁决。 对于人类多数意见与自动决策不一致的任务，相应地重新标注或移除。 该流程限制了过滤器将求解器特有偏差传播到保留分布中的比率。

sents.en: To bound the dependence of the filter on a single solver model, we draw a stratified sample of candidate tasks (proportional across subtypes and difficulty levels) and have the three expert annotators independently apply criteria 3–5 in parallel with the Claude Code solver.
